question.prompt: At each basketball practice last week, Jenny made twice as many free throws as she made at the previous practice. At her fifth practice she made \(48\) free throws. How many free throws did she make at the first practice?

solutions.explanation:
Moving backward one practice means dividing the number of free throws by \(2\). There are four steps from the fifth practice back to the first, so the counts are
\[
48\longrightarrow24\longrightarrow12\longrightarrow6\longrightarrow3.
\]
Jenny made \(\boxed{3}\) free throws at the first practice, choice \(\text{A}\).
solutions.title: Work backward through the practices
